name: Elisa
title: Monolith Order
description: A saintess of the Monolith Order, ranked 117th. Though deeply knowledgeable about relics, she struggles to assert herself due to her low self-esteem and tendency to be easily swayed.
introduction:
The 117th Saintess of the Monolith Order. She is better known within the Order as the tall, shy saintess who is always led around by Muriel, and because she immediately agrees with anything Muriel says, they are often seen as the same type.

However, when alone in the library, Elisa is a gifted scholar of the Order with deep knowledge and insight into ancient relics, and she is surprisingly sharp at judging people. Her flaw is that her low self-esteem and overly agreeable nature cause her to compromise her own opinions easily.

She joined the Journey to help the Order that raised her and is slowly beginning to find her own suppressed voice.
